scope: Read-only affected-route log classification and existing scheduler/runtime verification before 00070 completion; not a post-deployment smoke test

ingestDiagnosticClassification.classification: Expected read-only Magmo receipt probes for absent work-order documents, explicitly handled by the listener as None. These are not failed BlueFolder link imports.
ingestDiagnosticClassification.tombstoneDistinction: Existing deleted work orders return lifecycle context with deleted=true; the inspected handler returns not_found only when the document does not exist.
ingestDiagnosticClassification.countNote: HTTP request and application diagnostic streams are independently timestamped/indexed; their counts are not asserted as a one-to-one join.
